move.reason: Theatre hall shared by the Stadsschouwburg and Melkweg

move.title: Zaal 100, the stage for unheard sound
move.reason: Small stage for jazz and improvised music

move.title: Zuid-Afrikahuis, the library whose books were thrown in the canal
move.reason: Library and reading room open to the public; the story is about the library itself

borderline.title: A'DAM Toren and A'DAM Lookout
borderline.why unsure: Mixed tower: offices, hotel, club, restaurant and lookout; named Amsterdam Dance and Music, but the lookout and the 1971 Shell tower are the story

borderline.title: Akhnaton, the student club that let in salsa and hip-hop
borderline.why unsure: Former student club and music venue (hip-hop, house history); today a rented events venue

borderline.title: Beurs van Berlage
borderline.why unsure: Events venue (fairs, events) today, but the text is about the exchange building

borderline.title: Binnengasthuis, from dreaded hospital to university library
borderline.why unsure: University Library since 2025, but the text is mostly the hospital's history

borderline.title: Cineac, Duiker's newsreel cinema
borderline.why unsure: Duiker's newsreel cinema; later restaurant, event venue and club (from 2007); current use not stated clearly

borderline.title: Conservatorium van Amsterdam
borderline.why unsure: Music academy (a school) with concert halls; school category may be the better fit

borderline.title: Cruise Inn, the rock 'n' roll clubhouse on Zeeburgereiland
borderline.why unsure: Rock 'n' roll clubhouse with live bands and a festival; music club or bar (food-drink)?

borderline.title: De Hallen (Westelijke Tramremise)
borderline.why unsure: Mixed complex: film house, food hall, library branch, shops, hotel

borderline.title: De Nieuwe Anita, the living-room venue on the Frederik Hendrikstraat
borderline.why unsure: Cultural cafe with small gigs, poetry, cabaret; music venue or bar?

borderline.title: Gemaal Kadoelen and the Concertgemaal
borderline.why unsure: Pumping station that also hosts about ten classical concerts a year and rents desks; story is the pumping stations

borderline.title: Gerardus Majellakerk and its Catholic enclave (NedPhO-Koepel)
borderline.why unsure: Church turned NedPhO-Koepel concert and rehearsal hall, but the place covers the whole Catholic enclave (presbytery, convent, schools)

borderline.title: Heineken Experience
borderline.why unsure: Brand museum/attraction in a listed brewery; museum or industrial?

borderline.title: Het Veem
borderline.why unsure: Squatted warehouses turned cultural work building with the mime stage Veem House for Performance

borderline.title: Maison Stroucken, the party hall inside DeLaMar
borderline.why unsure: The 1881 party hall is now part of the DeLaMar theatre, but the text is about Maison Stroucken's history

borderline.title: Maloe Melo, the blues café on the Lijnbaansgracht
borderline.why unsure: Blues cafe whose main role is live music and jam sessions; music venue or food-drink?

borderline.title: NDSM Loods (Scheepsbouwloods)
borderline.why unsure: Shipbuilding hall holding an 'art city' of artists' studios; art space or industrial heritage?

borderline.title: Nieuwe Kerk, the church without a tower
borderline.why unsure: Church not used for regular worship, a ticketed exhibition venue; story is the church and its tombs

borderline.title: Nieuwe Waalse Kerk, now a museum of illusions
borderline.why unsure: Former church, since 2025 the Museum of Illusions (commercial attraction)

borderline.title: Odeon, from brewery to concert hall to gay disco
borderline.why unsure: Former concert hall and gay disco; today club-restaurant and bars

borderline.title: Old trade school on the Timorplein, Aart Roos's mural and Studio/K
borderline.why unsure: Converted trade school; Studio/K (student cinema and club) is one tenant, the largest is a hostel

borderline.title: Oude Kerk
borderline.why unsure: Oldest church, also a contemporary art centre since 2012 with a ticket; still has services?

borderline.title: Parnassusweg 220: the 'concrete court' that is becoming a museum
borderline.why unsure: Ex-courthouse being converted into the Hartwig Museum, opening planned 2028; not a venue yet

borderline.title: Plantage Dok, the squat that bought itself
borderline.why unsure: Squat-turned-collective workspace with the Dokzaal hall and a gallery open to outsiders

borderline.title: Polanenstraat block and Polanentheater
borderline.why unsure: Housing block whose former school is the Polanentheater; subject is the housing block

borderline.title: Read the facade of the Colonial Institute
borderline.why unsure: Wereldmuseum building, but the place is about reading the facade

borderline.title: Rock Club The Cave, the metal basement on the Prinsengracht
borderline.why unsure: Rock and metal basement bar with bands at weekends; bar or music venue?

borderline.title: Sexyland, the club with 365 owners
borderline.why unsure: Club/culture venue but currently without a home; NDSM Theater opening planned spring 2027

borderline.title: Splendor, the bathhouse of the Jewish island
borderline.why unsure: Today the Splendor music club, but the place is about the Jewish bathhouse and its war history

borderline.title: The Stopera, the NAP under it and the Violist
borderline.why unsure: Town hall and national opera house in one building; text is about the NAP, the Violist and the marriages

borderline.title: Tolhuistuin and the Shell canteen
borderline.why unsure: Garden with the Tolhuistuin cultural centre and Paradiso Noord in the Shell canteen; park or culture?

borderline.title: Vleeshal and the Brakke Grond gate, theatre and anatomy over the meat
borderline.why unsure: Flemish cultural centre and theatre De Brakke Grond, but the place centres on the meat hall and its gate

borderline.title: Vrankrijk
borderline.why unsure: Squat cafe with punk concerts, debates and bar nights; bar or venue?

borderline.title: Werf 't Kromhout and the yard bosses' houses
borderline.why unsure: Working-museum shipyard (open two days a month); museum or industrial heritage?

borderline.title: Westbeat and the dancers' Super Space (Lelylaan)
borderline.why unsure: Housing block on arches with ICK Dans Amsterdam's studios and performance hall underneath

borderline.title: Westergasfabriek
borderline.why unsure: Gasworks ensemble now a cultural park: cinema, event spaces, restaurants, TV studios

borderline.title: Wittenberg (Luther Museum)
borderline.why unsure: Short-stay hotel with the Luther Museum in the regents' rooms

borderline.title: Zaagmolenschool and Filmhuis Cavia
borderline.why unsure: Former school now artists' and theatre workshops plus Filmhuis Cavia
